changes_made.explanation: Consolidated tasks to single 'Other: Post-OCR Error Correction', normalized model names to standard forms (GPT-2, GPT-2 XL), removed duplicate '3-gram model', and clarified output description. Added GPT-2 XL which was mentioned in the paper.
Consolidated 'WER' into full 'Word Error Rate (WER)' for clarity and consistency
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper - the LMs were used for generation/reconciliation only
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper - only automatic evaluation using WER

overall_notes: This paper focuses on unsupervised post-OCR error correction using language models to reconcile multiple OCR views. The NLG aspect is the generation of corrected text by selecting the most probable reconciliation from multiple OCR inputs. The paper uses Word Error Rate as the sole evaluation metric and does not conduct human or LLM-as-judge evaluations. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization and consolidation of duplicate entries.
